title: Randy
desc: _Randy will buy certain high-end vehicles at his showroom, and offers repairs and resprays._

title: Moses
desc: _Moses will buy low-key untracked vehicles at his auto shop, and offers repairs and resprays. He'll also register them as personal vehicles, for a fee._

title: Yasmani
desc:
_Yasmani will buy stolen goods at his shop. For an extra cut, he'll arrange a pick-up from your garage._

**Drop-off Prices:**
- Narcotics: Medium
- Jewelry: Highest
- Marked Bills: Highest

title: Tyrone
desc:
_Tyrone will buy stolen goods at his apartment, paying a good price for narcotics._

**Drop-off Prices:**
- Narcotics: Highest
- Jewelry: Medium
- Marked Bills: Medium

title: Dunk's Trailer
desc:
_Dunk will pay what little he can for any stolen goods dropped off at his trailer._

**Drop-off Prices:**
- Narcotics: Low
- Jewelry: Low
- Marked Bills: Very Low

title: Kenton
desc: _Kenton runs diving tours from his shop in Key Lento. He'll pay a finder's fee for any treasure found on the ocean floor, plus a bonus if he finds the right buyer._

title: Brian's Lockup
desc:
_Brian will pay for any narcotics, jewelry and marked bills dropped off at his lockup._

**Drop-off Prices:**

- Narcotics: Very Low
- Jewelry: Very Low
- Marked Bills: Very Low
